_comment: Interim 360 tour. Order = walking order main gate -> inner gate. fwd = horizontal position (0..1) in the photo that points toward the NEXT stop; the Back arrow points the opposite way. Edit title/fwd per stop to fine-tune. Photos p01-p22 were shot walking main->inner; p23-p96 were shot walking inner->main, so they run in reverse here. Route graph: a stop may have "end":true (no forward arrow), "id", "prev" (Back goes to that id) and "links":[{"to":id,"u":0..1}] for a fork (extra forward arrow).
